content.en: The WTO operates on the principle of **Most Favored Nation (MFN)** treatment and **National Treatment**, ensuring non-discrimination in international trade. The **Agreement on Agriculture (AoA)** is the most significant framework for India, focusing on market access, domestic support, and export competition.
